source: ECOSORN project leaflet, "សណ្តែកសៀង (ពូជក្នុងស្រុក)" [Soybean (local varieties)], 2-page farmer extension leaflet
text: Fertilizer application is scheduled in stages tied to the crop's growth: an initial application at or before sowing followed by a top-dressing during vegetative growth. As a legume, soybean is noted as needing comparatively modest nitrogen fertilizer once root nodulation is functioning, with the leaflet emphasizing timely, split applications over one large dose.
